title: DSA Learning Roadmap
recommended_study_method: Implement or explain the data structure/algorithm.
Test edge cases and compare alternatives.
Review prior concepts before moving to specialist topics.

phases.title: Foundation
phases.milestone: Analyze simple algorithms and explain their time and space complexity.

phases.title: Linear structures and essential algorithms
phases.milestone: Implement foundational structures and solve common array and string problems.

phases.title: Trees and specialized structures
phases.milestone: Select and implement suitable structures for query and update requirements.

phases.title: Graphs and algorithm design
phases.milestone: Model complex problems and justify why an algorithm works.

phases.title: Advanced techniques
phases.milestone: Explain advanced algorithms and their practical or theoretical limitations.

phases.title: Professional implementation and application
phases.milestone: Deliver a tested project and explain algorithms, complexity, design choices, and limitations.

optional_specializations.title: Competitive Programming
topics: Advanced dynamic programming and bitmask DP
Segment trees and binary search on answers
Advanced graph algorithms and complex patterns

optional_specializations.title: Data Structures for Systems and Databases
Theoretical Computer Science
topics: Asymptotic lower bounds and complexity classes

progression_note: Advance based on demonstrated understanding and testing, not merely by completing the lesson list.
